about: Grades against the papers (ASSISTANT grades, not an independent review). Run: c6 + prompt p7 + verifier v4.6c, setting B, real Groq, 2026-11-14, the 25 frozen questions of assessment/improvement_loop/datasets/datasets.json (E25_p7_v46_c6/).

q01.why: sequential h_t from h_(t-1) precludes parallelization; critical at long lengths as memory limits batching

q02.why: h=8, d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 (verbatim AIAYN:3.2.2:c014; reads in the paper's 'we' voice)

q03.why: predicts time-aligned text tokens before audio tokens; improves factuality and linguistic quality; almost triples accuracy (MOSHI:1:c007, 5.5:c091)

q06.why: real tokenization limitations from HNET:A:c088, not the expected motivation (barrier to end-to-end models); expected gold not retrieved

q07.why: third sub-layer over encoder output; masked decoder self-attention; Q from previous decoder layer, K/V from encoder output

q09.why: 160 ms via acoustic delay 2 -> 1, 200 ms in practice, 160 ms below the 230 ms natural average; misses the 80 ms Mimi frame (12.5 Hz) part of the 160 ms

q13.why: 55.5 vs 53.3 at GPT-3 Large; Transformer at GPT-3 XL 55.5 (raw row phrasing)
